360	So, he wanted to elevate the position of Nasi: from today, we no longer stand for the sages, nor for the head of the court, only
361	for the Nasi.
362	Hear this: you ruled, you sealed it, it's done, that's the ruling.
363	I told you, a Nasi has the power to decree decrees and to enact laws.
364	Rabbi Meir entered the study hall, and they did not stand.
365	Look at them, they look at him, they don't stand for him.
366	Suddenly Rabbi Natan entered, and they did not stand.
367	He said to them, it's not for my honor, okay?
368	What's going on here, what's going on?
369	Come, explain to me, what is happening here today?
370	They said, the Nasi decreed that no one stands for anyone, only for the Nasi.
371	What, really?
372	They told him, yes.
373	We stand only for the Nasi, that's it, that's what he enacted, it's over, we no longer stand for you.
374	If you like, we'll do it this way: hiddur, "and you shall honor the face of the elder," and of course we'll keep calling you "Chacham,"
375	the rabbinic titles and all that, but we don't stand.
376	Rabbi Meir heard this, and Rabbi Meir was fiery, sharp. I told you, it seemed as if he were uprooting mountains,
377	uprooting mountains and grinding them against each other.
378	Rabbi Meir came to Rabbi Natan and said, look, this is how it is, there is a ruler over every
379	scheme.
380	What are we?
381	Are we going to just stand by here, in a marsh?
382	Sanhedrin 33?
383	Are we going to cut down the reeds, in the swamps?
384	In the marshes?
385	We also worked hard, we spat blood for this Torah.
386	What will he do?
387	He says they won't stand for us?
388	Let's remove him from his position, my friend, that's the end.
389	It's over.
390	Let's do this.
391	He doesn't know the tractate Uktzin.
392	I know that he didn't learn the tractate Uktzin.
393	Let's go tomorrow into the study hall and ask him questions in tractate Uktzin,
394	and he won't know how to answer, and then what will happen is what is written in the verse: "Who can utter the mighty acts of HaShem, make all His praise heard?"
395	Whoever knows a great deal of Torah can make all His praise heard,
396	he can utter the mighty acts of HaShem, and he is fit to be appointed Nasi. With all due respect,
397	Rashbag, Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel, you don't know?
398	Vacate the seat, here is Rabbi Natan, who also knows tractate Uktzin.
399	We'll make you Nasi, and I will be Av Beit Din in your place.
